name: Anabisetia
sum: A small, bipedal herbivorous ornithopod about 2 m long from the Late Cretaceous of Neuquén, Patagonia, Argentina.
wsnote: Around 2 m long, according to the English Wikipedia revision cited.
holotype: MCF-PVPH 74, the most complete of four specimens, with fragmentary skull material (partial braincase and both dentaries), a complete forelimb and hindlimb and vertebrae from all regions.
material: Paratypes MCF-PVPH-75 and MCF-PVPH-76 and referred specimen MCF-PVPH-77, adding more vertebrae, a complete pelvis and a nearly complete articulated tail.
biology: A small bipedal herbivore; no further habits are described in the sources consulted.
author: Coria and Calvo 2002

sources.text: R. A. Coria and J. O. Calvo. 2002. A new iguanodontian ornithopod from Neuquén Basin, Patagonia, Argentina. Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology 22(3):503-509
